name: Nine
source:
On the anniversary of their best friend's disappearance (presumed suicide), Nine (real name unknow) yearns to find evidence of an afterlife in the hope of being reunited with her.

When pushed from a rooftop, Nine is set to discover much more about what happenes to the dead than they ever dreamed of.
